eventDetail.scope: Human-centric robotics development is a mandatory challenge for real deployment of cooperative, trustworthy and acceptable robotic solutions and services. Digital transformation will also involve robotics, favoring synergies with artificial intelligence and IOT and spreading their use in every daily life environments. Robotics for sustainability in today's world is a promising challenge to address climate change, enhance recycling, make manufacturing, mobility, food and daily life more and more.
